data.report: November 28, 2026 | 8:05 AM Partly sunny skies are in the forecast today, with a high near 49°F and calm winds. Warmer temperatures should help soften the snow throughout the day. 17 lifts are scheduled to operate today, serving 153 open trails across Palisades and Alpine. Today’s Mountain Tip: Check out Belmont Park, where features are stacked from side to side. With warmer weather helping soften the snow, today is a great day to get creative, try a new trick, or work on something you’ve been wanting to dial in. Safety Reminder: Early season conditions exist, including low snow, hidden obstacles, and open creeks. Watch for marked and unmarked hazards, and use extra caution when returning to the base area as multiple runs merge together. Stay aware of your surroundings and give other skiers and riders plenty of space. Have a great day on the mountain! -Dom For real-time information at your fingertips, download the Ikon Pass App for updates on lift status, events, weather, and more.
